name: milyonus
description: Make videos programmatically with React. MIT licensed.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @milyonus/core && npm run build -w @milyonus/player && npm run build -w @milyonus/cli && npm run build -w hello-world && npm run build -w data-explainer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/player --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-world --noEmit && tsc -p examples/data-explainer --noEmit
scripts.test: npm test -w @milyonus/core && npm test -w @milyonus/player && npm test -w @milyonus/cli
